event_chain.summary: Former employee took patient data to solicit for competitor

summary: Women's Wellness of Southern Delaware found on April 28, 2026 that a former aesthetics service provider (employee) had kept patient contact and clinical information after their engagement ended and used it to solicit patients for a competing practice. Aesthetics patients' names, contact details, medications, allergies and service photos and records, and clinical patients' names, phone numbers and purchase/medication information were involved.
